description: The line plot illustrates the comparison of Macro-F1 scores between two different tokenization methods across varying numbers of tokens. The x-axis, labeled "Number of tokens," is a linear scale ranging from 0.6 to 1.5. The y-axis, labeled "Macro-F1 Score (%)," is also a linear scale ranging from 48% to 58%. The plot features two lines: one in red, representing the "MATTER (ours)" method, and one in purple, representing the "w/o material information" method. The red line shows a fluctuating performance with a peak at around 1.0 tokens and a notable dip at 1.4 tokens. The purple line exhibits a more consistent performance with minor fluctuations, maintaining a score just above 52% across the range of tokens.
